hypothesis: moderate class-balanced source sampling and less supplemental dilution may improve five-class Earthmoving transfer
sampling: within each source choose class with probability proportional to sqrt(class row count), then choose a row uniformly within that class; with replacement
model: same round2 ActionNet temporal as joint v1; Rathan still bypasses temporal head
temporal_input: same full RGB frame letterbox fixed 8-frame candidate clips as joint v1
rathan_input: same single published Idle bbox crop as joint v1; never repeated as video
validation: unchanged 85 Earthmoving clips; five-class Macro-F1; earliest best epoch wins
test: do not read or evaluate until all nine runs complete and validation selection is frozen
continuous_test: fixed 64-frame history, stride 8, EMA alpha 1.0; best validation clip seed per arm
known_limits: only two Earthmoving training Move intervals exist; balanced sampling repeats them and cannot create new scenes
KIT labels, original-video groups and independent data use terms remain provisional
Rathan Idle is a static publisher label and original footage rights are unconfirmed
the original Earthmoving test set has been viewed in earlier experiments
C has extra still-image compute; A/B/C have equal temporal draws and optimizer updates
